reviews.title: Excellent floor chair
reviews.body: I’ve been using this floor chair in both personal and clinical-adjacent settings, and it has exceeded expectations in a few key areas that actually matter over time: stability, sustained comfort, and functional versatility.First, stability is immediately noticeable. Many floor chairs tend to shift or subtly collapse under load, especially with repeated repositioning. This one maintains structural integrity even with longer sitting sessions and dynamic posture changes. The base feels well-balanced, and the dual-backrest system doesn’t introduce the wobble you might expect from a more articulated design.The dual-backrest configuration is the real differentiator. Instead of forcing a single curvature, it adapts to your thoracolumbar profile in a way that feels more like distributed support than a fixed brace. Over longer sessions, that translates to less paraspinal fatigue and fewer unconscious posture corrections. Whether upright for reading or slightly reclined, the support remains consistent rather than diminishing over time.Comfort is also notably above average. The high-density cushioning strikes a useful balance, firm enough to maintain posture but compliant enough to avoid pressure buildup. The wider seat matters more than you’d think; it allows subtle positional shifts without losing support, which is critical for longer use.Finally, the portability is practical rather than gimmicky. It folds cleanly, stands upright, and is easy to move between rooms without feeling fragile.Overall, this is a well-engineered product that goes beyond comfort marketing claims. It meaningfully improves the biomechanics of floor sitting while opening up some interesting use cases beyond casual lounging.

reviews.title: pros and cons
reviews.body: As a Korean, sitting on the floor is a big part of my daily life, and finding a comfortable and supportive floor chair has been a priority. This has been a great addition to my routine, and here’s my personal experience with it.Pros:1. Ergonomic Design: The dual-backrests provide excellent support for my back, making long periods of sitting much more comfortable. The ergonomic design helps maintain good posture, which is crucial for preventing back pain.2. Comfortable Cushioning: The chair is cushy and provides a good amount of padding. It’s sturdy yet comfortable, making it ideal for extended use. Whether I’m working, reading, or watching TV, this chair keeps me comfortable throughout.3. Sturdy Construction: The build quality is impressive. The chair feels solid and well-made, giving me confidence that it will last a long time.4. Convenient for Floor Sitting: As Koreans typically sit on the floor, this chair is perfect for our lifestyle. It offers the support we need while still allowing us to maintain our cultural practice of floor seating.Cons:1. Size: The chair is a bit small for larger individuals. While it’s perfect for me, someone with a bigger frame might find it less accommodating.2. Heat Retention: After sitting for long periods, especially in warmer weather, the chair can cause some sweating. It’s something to be mindful of if you tend to sit for extended periods.Despite these minor drawbacks, this has been a great investment for my daily comfort. It’s sturdy, comfy, and fits perfectly with my lifestyle of sitting on the floor. So far, it has served me well, and I’m pleased with its performance.

reviews.title: Decent Chair, But Not as Comfortable as Expected
reviews.body: The Dual-Backrests Ergonomic Floor Chair with Back Support looked like the perfect solution for reading and gaming on the floor, and while it’s okay, it didn’t quite meet my expectations for comfort. The dual-backrest design is interesting and does offer some support, but after sitting for a while, it’s not as cozy as I had hoped. It’s lightweight, easy to fold, and the blue color looks nice, so it’s fine for short sessions just not something I’d want to sit in for hours.

reviews.title: Sturdy, comfortable, well built
reviews.body: Got the faux leather one (black), received 1 week ago, using it for several hours every day, I weight 154lb:- so far very good, great back support for sitting on the floor, and comfortable- folding is extra welcome as I can put it away vertically without taking much space- sitting cushion is comfy yet firm- sitting cushion size generous too, but not too big: measures 18" by 16"- as other reviewer reported, flexes a little as you put your weight on the back rest, but it's made of thick strong plastic and metal, so I'm sure this thing will last for years of useGreat product, a bit pricey, but happy with my purchase
